title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
engineRationale: A visually spectacular military sci-fi: the zero-gravity Battle Room, Formic (Bugger) ships, the fleet, Command School's simulated invasion. The concept is carried by concrete external set-pieces on an epic scale, not internal/abstract states — photoreal Flux cinematic stills (Vox) render the spectacle far better than a flat-vector everyman rig.
